sentences.text:
Author: Pankaj Purohit
Bench: Manoj Kumar Tiwari, Pankaj Purohit
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders
Sl. or proceedings
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No or directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  CRLA No.315 of 2024  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Ravi Joshi, Advocate for the appellant.
Mr. Rakesh Kumar Joshi, Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.
2. This is an Appeal against conviction.

By the impugned judgment dated 30.03.2024 passed by Special Judge (POCSO Act), Tehri Garhwal in Special Sessions Trial No.55 of 2021, appellant was convicted for the offence punishable under Section 376(3), 376(2)(n) I.P.C. and Section 5 (l)
readwith Section 6 and Section 13/14 of POCSO Act and Section 67-B of I.T. Act and was awarded maximum punishment of 20 years rigorous imprisonment with fine of 10,000/-.
The fine was also awarded under the other sections, in which appellant was convicted.
3. As per office report, there is delay of 11 days in filing the Appeal.
4. Learned State Counsel submits that he do not propose to file any objection to the delay condonation application and delay be condoned.

5. For the reasons furnished in the affidavit filed in support of delay condonation application, the delay condonation application (I.A. No.1 of 2024) is allowed and the delay in filing the Appeal is condoned.
Let trial Court's record be summoned.
